title: CAF-Gen：用于丰富论证结构的多智能体系统
summary: CAF-Gen是一个自动化的多智能体框架，通过迭代的创建者-审阅者流程，将浅层论证结构丰富为符合Carneades论证框架的模型。实验表明，迭代反馈循环提高了数据质量，并与原始注释实现了强对齐，克服了单次生成模型的局限性。
summary_en: CAF-Gen is an automated multi-agent framework that enriches shallow argument structures into CAF-compliant models via an iterative Creator-Reviewer pipeline. Experiments show the feedback loop improves data quality and alignment, overcoming single-pass generation limitations.
